name: sidebar
description: Main Menu (called Sidebar before): one top-level menu with a tab for each of your installed mods, switched-off mods dimmed, and Mod Settings always last, in the Bottom Bar's colours.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn off to stop the Main Menu opening or drawing anything; /doole_main-menu then only says it is off.

startTab.title: Tab it opens on
startTab.description: Which tab the Main Menu shows when it opens: the one you used last, its own page, or a particular mod. Default: last used.

reopenOnStart.title: Reopen at session start
reopenOnStart.description: Reopen the Main Menu in a new session if it was left open last time. Default: on.

showFooter.title: Show the footer
showFooter.description: Show Context's footer (Hindsight, CodeGraph, git, test passes) at the bottom of every tab. Default: on.

showBadges.title: Show tab badges
showBadges.description: Show the number badges other mods put on their tabs. Default: on.
